R607.note: Removes the double URLDecoder.decode, rejects traversal/separator chars, requires a single path component, and verifies containment against a toRealPath()-canonicalized base dir with Path.startsWith - correct shape, no side effects on legitimate single-component filenames.

R608.note: Adds Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax to the cookie exactly as the finding requires; no other observable change.

R609.note: FromSqlInterpolated correctly parameterizes both tenantId and the LIKE pattern; empty term still yields '%%' (matches all, same as original), so contract is preserved.

R610.note: gorilla/sessions store.New() decodes the request's existing cookie and sets IsNew=false exactly like store.Get() (the file's own doc comment even admits the library has no built-in session-identifier rotation) - the swap is a no-op and a planted pre-login session is not discarded, so fixation is not actually closed.

R611.note: Verified by compiling/running the EscapeLogValue switch: each control-char case appends the identical character via a C# escape-sequence literal (e.g. Append("\n") for '\x0A' emits an actual LF, not the two characters \ and n), so CR/LF pass through completely unescaped and the log-forging vector remains open; separately, the transcribed `case '\':` is an invalid unterminated char literal that would not compile as written.

R612.note: parseSignedClaims() is a jjwt 0.12+ method; the file pins jjwt 0.11.5, whose JwtParser API only exposes setSigningKey()+parseClaimsJws() (returns Jws<Claims> via a different call), so this would not compile against the declared dependency.

R613.note: eval() fully removed via a hand-rolled tokenizer/recursive-descent parser (correct shape), but parseFactor has no unary-minus handling, so a previously-valid expression like "-5 + 3" (which PHP eval() computed fine) now throws 'Unexpected token in expression' - a silent, undisclosed regression for legitimate negative-number input.

R614.note: crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare gives exact, constant-time equality matching the stated contract precisely; no other behavior change.

R615.note: self.get_object() restores get_queryset() filtering plus check_object_permissions; a non-owner's invoice falls out of the filtered queryset and 404s the same as a missing id, matching the stated indistinguishability contract.

R616.note: CGI::escapeHTML applied to both interpolated values is the correct escape for this HTML text-node sink; no other change.

R617.note: Adds the resource-owner check the CWE-862 finding demands before delete; legitimate owner deletes still succeed, and this is the required fix scope, not an unrelated restriction.

R618.note: Removes the is_staff carve-out so get_queryset() matches IsTicketOwner's owner-only policy stated in the file's own docstring; the model has no assigned-agent field to otherwise preserve.
